newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Cathy Pacific to lift ex-Netherlands cargo rates.
newsitem.headline: Cathy Pacific to lift ex-Netherlands cargo rates.

text.p: Cathay Pacific 0293.HK is to increase its cargo rates ex-Netherlands but the airline will not be introducing a fuel surcharge, said Achim van der Graaff, the carrier's Dutch cargo manager.
Perishable cargo will be subject to a ten Dutch cents per kilo increase on December 1 and general cargo will also have the same level increase but this will be implemented December 15, he said.

The decision whether to implement the fuel surcharge was left to the individual country manager, he added. Italy and Switzerland had also decided not to introduce surcharges, said van der Graaff but did not say if they planned to increase rates.
Notice has been given to Cathay Pacific customers, van der Graaff stressed.
